name: sallitna-workspace
description: Shortcuts for the whole project. Each app has its own package.json in frontend/ (no libraries here).

scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db push --linked
scripts.db:test: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db query --linked -f supabase/tests/rls_test.sql
scripts.db:push:test: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db push --db-url "$SUPABASE_TEST_DB_URL"
scripts.db:test:test: cd backend && npx --yes supabase db query --db-url "$SUPABASE_TEST_DB_URL" -f supabase/tests/rls_test.sql
scripts.functions:deploy: cd backend && npx --yes supabase functions deploy notify --use-api
scripts.functions:deploy:test: cd backend && npx --yes supabase functions deploy notify --use-api --project-ref "$SUPABASE_TEST_REF"
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p .
